resolution.summary: Added canonical Rust SRT import preserving cue times with estimated word timing, atomic validation, superseded pending inference and Undo/archive support. Captions now exposes canonical Local/External API choice and account-scoped OpenAI-compatible endpoint/model/key configuration. External requests use bounded audio sections, existing durable checkpoints, account/config binding, cancellation and retries; keys stay host-side outside project exports. Rebuilt browser WASM/manifests. Real Chrome verified settings UI and Hebrew/English SRT import, transcript word controls and enabled correction actions; undid synthetic captions. Proof: .local/transcription-debug/srt-import-proof.png. Expanded broad regression suite timeout after its 90-second harness limit, without assertion failures.

remaining.summary: No live paid external API request was made because no API key was configured; transport/provider tests use controlled responses. Existing full three-hour speech-inference verification limit remains.
